differences.scope: Unconstrained developer-authored raw action controls, not Ant Design Button measurements
differences.note: Windows GPUI text advances vary with DPI. Original Action width differs by 1.09896 logical pixels at 150% scale. Equivalent fixed-width child probes isolate the Result layout gate.

differences.scope: Semantic root customization only; default Result has no border
differences.measurement: Opaque-ish blue pixel runs at physical y=21, x=30..709, max RGB-channel distance from #1677ff below 20; 100% scale. Browser runs are mostly 5/6px; native runs are 4px. These are raster runs, not CSS dash-length declarations.
differences.note: GPUI border_dashed uses a denser pattern than CSS dashed. Full pixel comparisons retain this difference; no Result-specific border painter overrides native StyleRefinement.

differences.scope: Custom GPUI div child containing raw text inside the body, notably unicode/rich/error RTL scenes
differences.note: Result preserves arbitrary native host subtrees. Stock GPUI text inside a custom div can keep a final period visually trailing, while browser CSS RTL places the neutral punctuation before the English run. This is not font antialiasing. Direct Result-owned body strings use the shared paragraph bidi path and are separately verified by the body-text scene.

differences.scope: Browser versus Windows GPUI glyph rasterization
differences.note: Full unaligned and unmasked canvas pixel errors are retained in visual-validation-windows.json. No font masking, rescaling, origin alignment, or interpolation is applied to the reported full-canvas errors.

visual_review.coverage: All original category groups, direct Result-owned RTL body text, eleven dark compact RTL representatives, and all six narrow exception categories in both directions at 100% scale.
visual_review.remaining_findings: The four rendering differences recorded above. No additional narrow exception discrepancy was found.
